search_scope: Targeted public ATLAS Run-2 HH bbgg and electron/photon performance papers; this is not a claim that no compatible input exists anywhere. Auxiliary portal access failed; absence is not inferred.

sources.object_definition: ATLAS tight converted/unconverted electromagnetic shower identification; calorimeter and track isolation; calibrated energy and DL1r jets; not the local Delphes photon model.
sources.transfer_factor_semantics: ID/isolation sideband composition fractions and sideband-normalized continuum mass model, not per-jet fake probabilities.

published_summary.scope: common preselection sideband composition, statistical and systematic components included

sources.applicability: Method reference only; local detector model, selection and control-data composition are not validated transfers. Fractions are not imported.
sources.uncertainties: Published composition errors include statistics and alternative photon-identification systematic; local correlated covariance/transfer validation unavailable.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0; public full text verified
sources.not_imported_reason: No compatible target-object jet fake transfer calibration and no local data control sample.

sources.object_definition: ATLAS isolated converted/unconverted tight photons; electron-control transfer uses tight identified and isolated electrons, pT>25 GeV, |eta|<2.37, transition excluded.
sources.transfer_factor_semantics: Prompt ID data/MC efficiency ratio; separate electron-to-photon transfer F=P(reco gamma and gamma ID|truth electron)/P(reco electron and electron ID|truth electron), applied to matching electron control yield. Neither is a jet-to-photon probability.
sources.applicability: No compatible Delphes shower shapes, conversion status, tracking, tight-ID control denominator or validated transfer closure; no rate imported.
sources.uncertainties: Prompt ID factors depend on pT and eta; electron transfer includes Z mass-window, energy-calibration and background-subtraction systematics. Target local covariance unavailable.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0; public full text verified
sources.not_imported_reason: Electron transfer and prompt efficiency differ in species and denominator from bb gamma jet fake model; local ATLAS object correspondence not established.

future_strategy: Freeze a target photon tight/anti-tight and isolated/nonisolated definition with explicit denominators, conversion status, pT, eta, jet flavour and b-tag environment.

For a separately authorized compatible data sample, measure ID-isolation sidebands in matched photon+jets or multijet control regions; fit prompt leakage and ID-isolation correlations, including two-candidate correlations.
Measure electron-to-photon transfer separately using a Z ee/e gamma control sample with the same electron denominator and conversion categories; do not reuse as a jet fake rate.
Validate transport into 0/1/>=2-tag and diphoton-mass regions with closure tests and covariance for shared events, subtraction, trigger and extrapolation.
Use separately authorized independent matched/merged prompt gamma+jets and decay/radiation-complete MC to test composition; any detector fake response must be data validated.

Only import a public calibration after source/version/license, object compatibility, transfer semantics, bin support, correlations and control-to-target closure pass; otherwise keep physical fake yield blocked.
